body:
I hit this twice during my first plugin's launch and filed #62400 before noticing yours. Closing #62400 as a duplicate and migrating the two reproducers here, because they suggest the validator's blind spot extends beyond `plugin.json` to other plugin asset files referenced by the manifest.

## Repro 1 — `userConfig.<field>.enum` in `plugin.json`

A `userConfig` entry with an `enum` array (the obvious shape if you're coming from JSON-Schema convention) is accepted by `claude plugin validate` and rejected by the runtime loader:

`.claude-plugin/plugin.json`:

```json
{
  "name": "demo-plugin",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "demo",
  "userConfig": {
    "framework": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Framework",
      "description": "Pick one",
      "enum": ["a", "b", "c"],
      "default": "a"
    }
  }
}
```

```
$ claude plugin validate .
✔ Validation passed
```

```
$ /plugin install demo-plugin@demo-marketplace
Failed to install: ... has an invalid manifest file at
/Users/<you>/.claude/plugins/cache/.../.claude-plugin/plugin.json.

Validation errors: userConfig.framework: Unrecognized key: "enum"
```

The plugins-reference docs list the supported `userConfig` field keys as `type, title, description, default, sensitive, required, multiple, min, max` — `enum` isn't in that set. But because `validate` doesn't open `plugin.json`, the violation never surfaces until install.

## Repro 2 — `hooks/hooks.json` missing the outer `hooks` wrapper

This one extends the bug beyond `plugin.json`. The validator also doesn't apply the runtime's schema to `hooks/hooks.json`:

`hooks/hooks.json`:

```json
{
  "PostToolUse": [
    {
      "matcher": "Write|Edit",
      "hooks": [
        { "type": "command", "command": "echo hi", "timeout": 5 }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

```
$ claude plugin validate .
✔ Validation passed
```

Then after `/plugin install`, `/doctor` shows:

```
Hook load failed: [
  {
    "expected": "record",
    "code": "invalid_type",
    "path": ["hooks"],
    "message": "Invalid input: expected record, received undefined"
  }
]
```

The runtime requires `{ "hooks": { "PostToolUse": [...] } }`. The unwrapped form (which matches what `~/.claude/settings.json` accepts and what older plugin docs show) passes the validator but fails at load.

Same closed/auto-locked report for this exact Zod error: #31763.

## Why this matters for the "Minimal Suggested Fix"

Your option 1 ("validate per-plugin `plugin.json`") covers Repro 1. Repro 2 suggests generalizing it slightly: the validator should descend into **every plugin asset whose schema the runtime loader enforces** — at minimum `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` and `hooks/hooks.json`, and presumably also `.mcp.json`, `.lsp.json`, `monitors/monitors.json`, `themes/*.json`. Each should be validated against the same Zod schemas the runtime uses, with errors reported back to the source file path.

Otherwise plugin authors keep shipping releases that pass `validate` and break at install — once per asset type, in a long tail. The Zod error messages the runtime already produces are excellent; making `validate` reuse them at CLI time would close the loop.

This issue has been automatically locked since it was closed and has not had any activity for 7 days. If you're experiencing a similar issue, please file a new issue and reference this one if it's relevant.
